partners.mechanism_chain: DCTN1 (HGNC:2766) —DISRUPTS→ Cytoskeletal dynamics and neuronal transport (GO:0007010); TUBA4A (HGNC:11672) —DISRUPTS→ Cytoskeletal dynamics and neuronal transport (GO:0007010); Cytoskeletal dynamics and neuronal transport (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Distal hereditary motor neuropathy (HP:0003693); Cytoskeletal dynamics and neuronal transport (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Spastic ataxia (HP:0001276). Mutations in DCTN1 (involved in dynactin complex function) and TUBA4A (a tubulin alpha chain) both disrupt the normal dynamics of the neuronal cytoskeleton and intracellular transport. This disruption in neuronal transport and cytoskeletal integrity leads to the characteristic phenotypes of distal hereditary motor neuropathy (disease A) and spastic ataxia (disease B).

partners.mechanism_chain: DCTN1 (HGNC:2792) —DISRUPTS→ dynein motor complex assembly and function (GO:0005875); NDE1 (HGNC:7713) —DISRUPTS→ dynein motor complex assembly and function (GO:0005875); dynein motor complex assembly and function (GO:0005875) —LEADS_TO→ neuronal development (GO:0048666); neuronal development (GO:0048666) —LEADS_TO→ distal hereditary motor neuronopathy (HP:0003690); neuronal development (GO:0048666) —LEADS_TO→ microhydranencephaly (HP:0033679).
